svg.title: Pulling a window to the monitor you are on
svg.desc: Two monitors. On the left, a blue window is unfocused and stacked behind a red one; on the right, a different window has focus. The cursor clicks the blue window's icon on the right monitor's taskbar, and focus moves to the blue window on the left. The mouse's back side button (Mouse4) is held and the middle button is clicked, and the blue window slides to the right monitor. Then the left monitor is turned off, leaving a grey dotted outline where the red window is. The red window's icon is clicked, and with the same buttons the red window slides out of the dark monitor to the right one.

g.text: Again, with the left monitor off
1. Click the icon: the window gets focus
2. Hold Mouse4: pull to this monitor
